name: House Tang Named Staff Deliberate Training Plans

facts.settlement_rule: Individual-lite named staff settle only through registry_processes#process_named_staff_quarterly; do not duplicate their development through the exact-character House Tang development clock.
facts.unit_training_rule: Troop and unit doctrine/training remains in its existing unit training contracts and is not duplicated here.
facts.evidence_rule: Planned hours are ceilings. Award development only from verified attended time with real duties, health, recovery, instructor, facility and equipment constraints; instruction or work time cannot be counted twice.
facts.missing_factor_rule: If an authoritative development input is absent, preserve the activity evidence and block unsupported permanent score awards rather than inventing the missing factor.

facts.focus: Governance, Law, Trade, Logistics, Training; estate accounting and audit practice
facts.facility: House Tang administration and accounting workspaces; Sword Manor operations office for relevant logistics exercises
facts.instructor_policy: role mentoring, ledger exercises, professional study, and supervised cross-training within real staff capacity
facts.duty_rule: accounting deadlines, treasury work, and audit obligations override deliberate training

facts.focus: Engineering, Training, Logistics, Trade, Defense; armory inspection and maintenance
facts.facility: Tang Forge and armory; Sword Manor equipment-use feedback sessions when lawful
facts.instructor_policy: craft practice, inspection exercises, maintenance review, and qualified instruction within material and instructor limits
facts.duty_rule: repair, production, custody, and safety work override deliberate training
